name: phone_case
title: Phone case
summary: Fitted case for the iPhone 17, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max or iPhone Air, sized from Apple's dimensional drawings. Rigid or TPU fit, open or covered buttons, optional name on the back, and a thin fit-test ring.

params.name: phone
params.help: which phone; the exact model matters, a 17 Pro case does not fit a 17 Pro Max

params.name: material
params.help: rigid (PLA, PETG, ABS) leaves 0.25 mm room per side; tpu (flexible) leaves 0.05 mm

params.name: wall
params.help: side wall thickness outside the phone

params.name: back
params.help: back plate thickness (Apple allows at most 2.1)

params.name: lip
params.help: how far the rim stands above the screen

params.name: buttons
params.help: cutout = open slots over the buttons; cover = covers you press through (Camera Control stays open)

params.name: camera_margin
params.help: extra room around the camera plateau

params.name: text
params.help: name or word engraved on the back; empty for none

params.name: slice
params.help: 0 = whole case; above 0 = print only the top this many mm as a quick fit-test ring (10 is a good test)

dims.x: (71.45 if phone == 'iphone_17' else 71.85 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro' else 77.98 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro_max' else 74.7) + 2 * ((0.05 if material == 'tpu' else 0.25) + wall) + (0.3 if buttons == 'cover' else 0)
dims.y: (149.61 if phone == 'iphone_17' else 150.01 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro' else 163.43 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro_max' else 156.18) + 2 * ((0.05 if material == 'tpu' else 0.25) + wall)
dims.z: min(slice, back + (7.95 if phone == 'iphone_17' else 8.75 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro' else 8.75 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro_max' else 5.64) + lip) if slice > 0 else back + (7.95 if phone == 'iphone_17' else 8.75 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro' else 8.75 if phone == 'iphone_17_pro_max' else 5.64) + lip
